## Imports

A `.py` file is a module; a directory with modules is a package. Prefer explicit imports (`from pkg.mod import thing`).

## Isolation

Use a virtual environment per project so dependencies don't collide. `python -m venv .venv` then activate.

## Modern tooling

`uv` creates envs and installs deps at Rust speed, replacing much of pip/venv/pyenv friction.

blocks.code:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install httpx
# or: uv venv && uv pip install httpx
